rv.q: The whole ensemble contributes to a thrilling play that both relives history and transcends it.
An unmissable and commanding theatrical tour de force.
This House is a remarkable achievement for all concerned.
This House is an outstanding play, and one that I would not hesitate to recommend to anyone.

cn.t: Critics rave about James Graham's *This House*, calling it a genius, enthralling slice of political history. Its behind-the-scenes look at Labour's fragile 1974-79 government feels sobering and urgently relevant today.
